buildNotes:
This build includes the following changes:
- Admin analytics dashboard (growth, product adoption, AI cost, optional Cloudflare Worker metrics)
- Scholar collaboration review sessions with guest links and comments
- Google Docs two-way sync for SOP, professor emails, and collaboration artifacts
- Admins skip scholar onboarding; default post-login route uses /auth/continue
- PostHog product analytics (off in local dev unless NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_DEV=true)
- UserActivityDay tracking for DAU/WAU
- build.json is the canonical app version (synced to package.json via pnpm version:sync)
